newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The World Trade Organisation has tried to reassure Moslem countries about trade liberalisation, saying they could benefit from the easing of restrictions.
- Saudi Arabia and Indonesia signed an agreement on mobile phone links between the two states.
- Saudi investors negotiated with Uzbek officials about ways to boost bilateral trade.
- Four educational projects worth 170 million riyals have been offered to local contractors.
- King Fahd met with Lebanon's Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri.
